journey.name: ED-03 Titles are trimmed and empty notes are dropped
journey.description:
Covers FR-02's normalisation, which lives in SaveTaskUseCase.kt:19-26 and nowhere else: the title is trimmed before it reaches the repository, and notes that trim to empty become null rather than an empty string.
The list row is the observable half of the title rule. The notes rule is observed by reopening the task: a null and an empty string both render as an empty field, so this journey asserts the part the user can see and leaves the null/empty distinction to SaveTaskUseCaseTest.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Tap the element with the content description "Add task"
Type " Buy milk " into the "Title" field, with leading and trailing spaces
Type three spaces into the "Notes (optional)" field
Verify that the app returns to the "Tasks" screen
Verify that a row reading exactly "Buy milk", with no leading or trailing spaces, is on screen
Verify that the title "Edit task" is on screen
Verify that the "Title" field contains exactly "Buy milk"
Verify that the "Notes (optional)" field is empty
